campaign.title: Blockwise linear owner completion and fixed-K reconciliation

resource_policy.literature_policy: No new external theorem is required. If a source is invoked, use primary sources and map it to the literal scalar owner norm.

frozen_target.question: Can every prior hard-top M2 owner be reinserted and subtracted blockwise in the oriented scalar pair sum with total outside-absolute cost O_epsilon(L^2 X^epsilon), thereby licensing a fixed-K completed directional vector, or which literal owner first prevents that completion?
frozen_target.reference_formula: Q_B^res=Q_B^comp-sum_nu O_(B,nu), with sum_(B,nu)|O_(B,nu)| <<_epsilon L^2 X^epsilon. The accepted aggregate identity E_L^top=E_owned,L+2 Re sum_B Q_B^res and E_owned,L <<_epsilon L^2 X^epsilon is not by itself the required norm.
quantities: K asymp JD/A, G asymp L/A, rho=AJD^3/L^3
Round-77 transform/error owners; Round-78 square owner; Round-79 exact-centre and rho-safe owners; Round-103/104 short-row owners
scalar signed, blockwise outside-absolute, row-energy, and positive Gram estimates are distinct
the metric density remains inside the completed coefficient

completion_criteria: Write a literal disjoint owner table in the oriented scalar normalization.
Prove or refute the exact completion identity for the fixed dyadic k-lattice and collared physical range.
For every owner prove the blockwise outside-absolute sum, give an explicit lawful bridge from its accepted energy estimate, or mark the first unsupported step.
Audit smooth Fourier and Mobius separation costs without assigning them to sharp pair-dependent owners.
Keep original Poisson modes distinct from the metric density mode.
Retain endpoints, floors, stars, half weights, collars, entry/exit, both orientations, empty/singleton fibres, q=1, squares, Pell, exact centres and rho=1.
Prove full completion, a strict partial completion with a named residual, or a rigorous no-go with the smallest replacement norm.
Leave the completed directional estimate, both smooth M2 packets, M9-M2, M9-M1, endpoint uniformity, M9 and the exponent open unless their exact dependency chain is proved.

tasks.target: Construct the literal owner dictionary and prove the strongest lawful full or partial fixed-K completion with every normalization and blockwise absolute cost visible.
required_output: A seven-section discovery/formalization report at the assigned path.

A full completion proof, strict partial completion, or first exact failing owner.

tasks.target: Hostilely audit every owner norm, its stability under outside absolute values and dyadic splitting, and the exact fixed-K/collar completion.
required_output: A seven-section hostile report at the assigned path.
A certification or the first exact unsupported implication.
A smallest lawful survivor and explicit state recommendation.

review_seams.requirement: Every owner has a literal formula, norm type, sign, block placement, and one-count priority.
Scalar, row-energy, positive Gram, and outside-absolute block estimates are not interchanged.
The fixed-K and physical-range complements equal the named owners exactly, including endpoints and zero extension.
Smooth separation costs are summable; sharp pair masks are estimated or separately subtracted, never silently factorized.
Square, Pell, q=1, exact-centre, rho-boundary, collar, floor, star, orientation and density controls pass.
No directional estimate, smooth packet, M9-M2, M9-M1, M9 or exponent is promoted without the exact bridge.
